summary.text: Maria Teresa Rodriguez, a Republican, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 3rd Congressional District to Morgan McGarvey.
Her campaign said she lived through political persecution before coming to the United States.

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez's campaign website describes her path as one "from political persecution to public service" and said she was running to defend freedoms she once lived without.
She won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for Kentucky's 3rd District, defeating David Nichter, Daniel Cobble and Donald Pay.
Her campaign site listed safe streets, a strong economy, lower taxes, legal immigration, protecting the unborn and protecting women's sports as priorities.
She received 29.7% of the vote to Morgan McGarvey's 70.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
